P.name: Time in a Bottle
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Zilean''' generates {{sti|Experience|{{as|{{pp|2;3.5;5;6;12|1;6;11;16;18}} experience}}}} (does not count towards his own [[Experience (champion)|level up]]) every 5 seconds. ''Time in a Bottle'' is on cooldown when the game starts and becomes disabled when '''Zilean''' and his allied champions have reached their {{tt|maximum level|On Summoner's Rift, level 20 for the champion in the top lane role and 18 for Zilean and all other allies.}}.
P.description2:
When he has stored enough {{as|experience}} to level up an allied {{tip|champion}} to their next level, he can {{tt|select them|Default MB2/right-click}} to {{tip|channel}} for {{fd|1.2}} seconds after a {{fd|0.5}}-second [[cast time]].

The channel is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} and disabled upon entering [[combat status|combat]] with enemy champions or taking damage from {{tip|turret|turrets}}, placing it on a {{sti|10-second cooldown}}. If '''Zilean''' interrupts it himself, it is placed on a 1-second cooldown, increased to 2 if he used a [[basic attack]] against a turret to do so. Additionally, if '''Zilean''' becomes affected by any form of {{tip|crowd control}}, the channel is placed on a 10-second cooldown.
P.description3: A successful channel will grant an equal amount of {{as|experience}} to the ally for them to level up as well as to '''Zilean''', with a combined minimum of 15% of the stored {{as|experience}}.
P.description4: '''''Zilean''' cannot initiate the channel while he is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables abilities.''

Q.name: Time Bomb
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' throws a ticking time bomb to the target location that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of its {{tt|surroundings|Cannot grant sight through terrain and can only grant sight into brush when the missile flies through that brush}} as it travels as well as while lingering in the area. The bomb will attach itself to units that move within the epicenter, or those hit directly at the time of the bomb's landing, {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and their surroundings.
Q.description2: {{tt|After 3 seconds|From when the bomb lands}}, or when the attached unit dies, the bomb explodes to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
Q.description3: The bomb detonates immediately if another bomb attaches itself to the same unit, {{tip|stun|stunning}} nearby enemies for a duration.

W.name: Rewind
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' reduces the {{sti|cd|'''remaining'''}} cooldowns of ''{{ai|Time Bomb|Zilean}}'' and ''{{ai|Time Warp|Zilean}}'' by 10 seconds each.
W.description2: ''Either {{ai|Time Bomb|Zilean}} or {{ai|Time Warp|Zilean}} must be on cooldown to cast this ability''.

E.name: Time Warp
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' applies ''Time Warp'' to the target champion which lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
E.description2: {{sbc|Time Warp:}} If the target is an ally, they gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}. If the target is an enemy, they are {{tip|slow|slowed}}.

R.name: Chronoshift
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zilean''' places a protective time rune on the target allied {{tip|champion}} or himself for 5 seconds.
R.description2: If the target takes {{tip|death|fatal damage}} within the duration, they enter {{tip|resurrection}} for 3 seconds, becoming {{tip|invulnerable}}, {{tip|untargetable}}, and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. Afterwards, they revive while being {{tip|heal|healed}}.
